title: Chapter 633
paragraphs: Chapter 633
Episode 163. Return of the Family (2)
Zipple, the Tower of Story.
The gazes of Kadun, Hedo, and Octavia were fixed on the news on the table.
(The hero of Geomhwangseongjeon, Jin Runcandel, the 12th generation Knight of the Sword Garden. He's returned after ending his secluded training!)
"So they're saying Jin Runcandel has returned..."
Octavia muttered in a low voice.
The 12th flagbearer Knight, who disappeared not long after Geomhwangseongjeon ended.
Hedo, who doesn't yet harbor any ill feelings toward Jin, looked unfazed, but the eyes of Octavia and Kadun were full of vitality.
'This is why the top brass of the World's Number One family always act like this towards a kid. There's no family head, so there's no restraint.'
Kelleyak Zipple.
He was currently receiving assistance from a chaos control device and a body maintenance device.
He was one of the most exposed to chaos in Geomhwangseongjeon alongside Rosa, so it was a given.
Until about a year ago, Kelleyak had been doing some external activities to hide Zipple's scar, but now he was in a position where he really had to 'save' time.
Until Zipple gains a perfect control of chaos, or until Kinzelo agrees to the trade.
'Well, I did take him lightly when I first met him in the Sota Desert...'
In retrospect, that was the problem.

If he had finished off Jin before Sandra caused a fuss in the Sota Desert, if he had struck Jin before he opened a path, or if he had stuck with Sandra and followed her when she fell in love with the Kaifa Army because of Jin...
He wouldn't have become such a big concern.
For Zipple, and for Hedo personally.
The fortunate thing, at least.
It was a fact that Jin, who had returned stronger, was not so bad for Zipple at this point.
Hedo spread out another piece of news laid beside the table.

(Dante Hylan has subjugated the demon of Gwigoksae Castle! As the successor to the late Ron Hylan, Dante is now seen as the Empire's premier guardian sword after entering the 10th rank following Geomhwangseongjeon...)
"The Smarion Proci of Gwigoksae Castle was probably subdued by the 12th Knight, not Dante."
"Why do you think so, Hedo?"

"Dante Hylan has been continuously appearing in the official stone statue. But there is no sign of injury, and none of his knights have died. No matter how powerful the imperial guardian sword is, it's unlikely that he could subdue such a chaos without any injuries. Only a single knight would risk his life to achieve that."
"That's true. But isn't it the same for Jin Runcandel?"
"That's uncertain. It depends on how strong the 12th Knight has become."
"Even with growth over 2 years and 6 months, to that extent?"
"He is, certainly, something other than human. Everyone here has experienced him deriving results that go beyond common sense."
"Even if that's the case, if he handled Smarion without any injuries, it would be due to Murakan recovering his power and reappearing."
Hedo nodded.
"Whether the 12th Knight has acquired power close to creation, or Murakan has regained his old strength. Neither is particularly bad for us at this moment."
Runcandel, a long-time rival of Zipple, who everyone thinks is falling. Zipple and Kinzelo were making a completely different judgment from the world's assessment.
"The Sword Garden. At this moment, there's no better piece than the 12th Knight to check them."
Hedo spreads out another piece of news on the table.
(The Sword Garden, it is known that they have discovered a relic of the founder, Temar Runcandel... No specific announcement, but a strong will to reclaim the family's forgotten history.)

"The 12th Knight probably doesn't know the current situation of Runcandel. So as soon as he returned, he felt something odd and announced his return to the world before the family. This is the response Runcandel showed afterwards."
After losing most of their history to Zipple a thousand years ago, Runcandel rarely disclosed issues about their ancestors to the public.
Especially mentioning Temar is the greatest taboo.
But now, the power of Zipple's story that oppressed Runcandel has weakened, and they no longer cared about Zipple's opinion.
They also didn't hide the 'Magic Affinity' phenomenon that occurred in the pureblood Runcandel after Geomhwangseongjeon.
There was only one reason they could do this.
Confidence.
The confidence that they had gained the power to no longer fear Zipple's threats....
"Those guys... Did they find Temar's tomb before the survivors of Hister? Through the power of the prophet?"
"Probably. But whether that's true or false is not important. What matters is that the moment the 12th Knight sees this article, he has no choice but to go to the family."
"To check on the life and death of Hister's survivor and the relics he should have obtained?"

"Not only that, it's an inevitable choice for Jin Runcandel to return to the family. Even to become the family head. He will never give up the family, even if Runcandel is not the same. Because he's not the type to compromise."

"As the Ghost Captain and Lord Kadun said. Of course, the 12th Knight won't go to the family unprepared. He will probably prepare an escape plan with the Eye of Frog possessed by the Vessel Lord, and it seems unlikely that he will bring the Vamel Alliance."
"Then he will certainly die there, Lord Hedo. He doesn't know how dangerous Runcandel is right now!"
Octavia was furious that the chance for revenge might disappear.

"No, Octavia. If Murakan has regained all his old power. Moreover, if his martial power, as Hedo says, has reached beyond the first level of superhuman... They could wage a war-like situation against Runcandel by themselves."
"And unless the 12th flagbearer chooses to obey Runcandel with the Vamel Alliance, a fight is inevitable in the Garden of Swords."
"He will never make such a choice."
Indeed, to what extent would Runcandel suffer in the process?
None of the three could estimate that.
However, all three of them agreed that the chances of Jin surviving were very low.
Even if Murakan fully regains his strength and supports him.
"Then we should take this opportunity to verify the power of Runcandel through their battle."
Zipple knows that the prophet has effectively seized control of the Garden of Swords with Rosa, and estimates their power to be beyond imagination.
But they didn't know exactly to what extent.
That's why they were avoiding a full-scale war using the previously established truce.
"Observing and gauging the situation is of course a good option. But I think it wouldn't hurt to go further."
"Going further...?"
Kadun and Octavia's gaze fell on Hedo.
"If Runcandel has weaker power than we expected, they will suffer serious damage in that fight."
Then it would be the perfect time to completely finish off Runcandel.
That's what Hedo was saying.
"We must not give them time to recover. You all remember how quickly the prophet resurrected the many knights who died in Sword Emperor Castle and how they were strengthened. Don't you?"
That was intelligence reported when Jin was in Lafrarosa.
The spy who informed them of the prophet's resurrection and reinforcement 'melted' and breathed his last in front of Kelliark as soon as the report was over.
In other words, at that time, the prophet was deliberately showing off his power.
Knowing that he was a spy.
Recalling the memories of that time, Kadun and Octavia shook their heads as if goosebumps were rising.
"So, Hedo, you're saying... we should prepare for a full-scale war?"
"I'm saying we need to prepare to respond depending on the situation of the battle. It's not an unconditional full-scale war."
"If the battle goes in a way that benefits both, we should finish off both... or back out if it doesn't feel right."
There was a moment of silence, and Kadun made a decision soon after.
"That would undoubtedly be the best scenario if it works out that way. But it's not something for us to decide. We should wake up Kelliark for a moment and let him make the judgement."
Then they went to the top floor of the Tower of Talk and informed Kelliark of the situation.
Kelliark, in the preservation device, nodded in agreement with Hedo's opinion.
Kinzelro New Headquarters.
At the same time, they were also having a meeting on the same topic as Zipple.
They were also reaching a similar conclusion as the Zipple side.
The person who suggested they should aim for a win-win situation was Bishkel Ivliano.

"Hmm, I think Deputy Chief's opinion is good... But will he really go to the Garden of Swords alone? He might have beaten Ranke, but it's crazy to visit the Garden of Swords, which even we can't touch easily, all by himself. Let alone that silly guy?"
"Hah! It seems that Jin Runcandel, who made Ranke look like a fool, doesn't see anything in his way!?"
Bubar and Ainas expressed doubts.
Ranke was sitting in the corner, mumbling to himself in a daze.
Every time he heard the expression that Jin 'beat' him, he glared at Ainas and Bubar as if he wanted to kill them.

"If Jin's head isn't messed up from simply trampling Ranke as Ainas suggests, I don't think he will go to the Garden of Swords. There's a big difference between beating Ranke and the entire Runcandel, a big difference. Oh, of course, it's not that Ranke is weak. He just lost...."
"Right, he just lost. So cheer up, Ranke."
Bishkel was disgusted by Bubar's incessant chattering of nonsensical words, as always.
"......Ainas, and Bubar. Stop emphasizing Ranke's defeat. It doesn't match the topic of the meeting, and it's disrespectful."
Tsk, tsk.
Ignoring Bishkel's words, the two took out sweet potato croquettes from their pockets and started eating, and Bishkel broke the pen he was holding.
"Hmm, what do you think, Chief?"
Marjiella patted Bishkel's shoulder and asked.

[The Deputy Chief is right. I'm sure Zipple also has a similar plan. If both Jin and Runcandel take a big hit, and we and Zipple attack Runcandel together. No matter how powerful the Garden of Swords is now, it would be difficult to cope.]
"So, Chief. Are we preparing for an all-out attack?"

[I think that would be good for now, Berakt. Although we need to monitor the situation later. There's no way Jin Runcandel will swear allegiance to the prophet... a fight will definitely occur. And Ainas, Bubar. Ranke's defeat is not a flaw. Jin Runcandel has become incomparably stronger than before.]
The direct assessment from the Chief made the executives' eyes widen.
Especially Zephilin, who had rarely seen Orgal give such high praise to a person during their long time together.

"Depending on how strong the hidden power of Runcandel is, it will determine the result. If it's weaker than we thought, it's an opportunity to sweep them all away. Master, you made a decision that fits my liking after a long time? I was getting annoyed having to keep an eye on that little thing."
[Zephilin, don't underestimate the Prophet.]
"Heh, I'm a poor dragon who has no memory of receiving your favor."
This time, Marjiella patted Zephilin's shoulder.
"Now that the Chief has given his approval, shall we prepare? Between the Garden of Swords and Jin Runcandel. The fight will inevitably hurt both, so it will be a fun event."
Marjiella grinned.
Perhaps thinking that this might be the last real chance to make Jin one of their own.
